Plant · 1 hex · SM -2 Awakened Shrub (Monsters on Automatic; answers SRD 5.1)

A waist-high bush that has been given a mind and, unluckily for it, a clear understanding of its position. It talks, it remembers who planted it, and it cannot defend itself against anybody with an axe. Most awakened shrubs end up as somebody's informant.

Notes

  • Racial cost: 0 points of traits plus 1 point of skills.

  • Movement: ground Move 2 (primary).
  • An awakened plant is awake in the full sense and will hold a conversation, which is generally why it is in the scene at all.
  • Fire is the obvious answer to it. There is no vulnerability on the stat block, so a GM should rule that at the table.
